title: Cherrygrove Surf Tentacool stays out of a land-only window

verification.actor: Cherrygrove population selection and native spawn-finalizer receipts; the saved Mankey follower only anchors the current field and gets no terrain-selection credit
verification.trigger: Wait for two natural Tentacool population attempts in the reviewed land-only window at (543,393)
verification.observable: Both attempts retain Surf terrain and resolver context, fail with no valid water target, and create no Tentacool Wild actor

setupMutations.change: Teleport directly to Cherrygrove (543,393), wait for the saved Mankey follower, and bind its current field identity. This gives no population, terrain-selection, or spawn-result credit.

limits: Covers two natural Tentacool attempts in one bounded Cherrygrove land-only window.
Does not prove Surf placement on loaded water, other species, other maps, or long-run population balance.

events.value: Teleport to the reviewed Cherrygrove land-only window
Observe two natural Tentacool finalizer attempts
Confirm Surf context, failed target, rejection, and no Tentacool actor

stop.condition: Two valid rejected Surf Tentacool attempts are observed

invariants: At least two Tentacool finalizer attempts use Surf terrain
Each Tentacool resolver request retains Surf encounter context
Each attempt retains target (-1,-1), returns failure, and cannot pair with a spawn
No active Wild Tentacool exists in the land-only observation window
